build_get_complete_url: build a SambaNova embedding URL by appending /embeddings to a base API endpoint
validate_environment_headers: validate environment headers for SambaNova embedding requests with API key fallback
transform_embedding_request: transform an OpenAI-compatible embedding request into SambaNova API format
transform_embedding_response: transform a raw SambaNova HTTP response into a structured EmbeddingResponse object
get_error_class: get a SambaNovaError exception class for a given error message and status code
